# Abhirup Kumar

> Abhirup Kumar is a software developer from Tarakeswar, near Kolkata, India. He builds web applications, AI tools, and systems software with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, and Rust.

## Portfolio

- [Profile](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/): Work, experience, skills, and background.
- [Projects](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects): Software projects with source repositories and development roles.
- [Achievements](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/achievements): Certifications, university recognition, and challenge milestones.
- [Journal](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog): Notes on design, software development, and the creative process.
- [Contact](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/contact): Email, professional profiles, résumé, and contact form.

## Project references

- [Distributed Linux Kernel Attestation System](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/distributed-linux-kernel-attestation): Building a distributed system to verify Linux kernel integrity in real-time using loadable kernel modules, Netlink communication, and quorum-based consensus to detect unauthorized kernel modifications.
- [CharmCrafter](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/charmcrafter): A modern web application built with React and TypeScript, featuring a responsive UI with shadcn-ui components and Supabase backend integration.
- [University Notes Platform](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/university-notes): Building a comprehensive platform for managing and sharing university course notes with modern web technologies and database integration.
- [Formethica - AI-Powered Form Builder](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/formethica): Building an intelligent form creation platform with AI-powered field suggestions, chatbot assistance, and advanced submission management with analytics and export capabilities.
- [Femway - Women's Safety Car Booking Platform](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/femway): Building a secure, role-based car booking platform specifically designed for women's safety and comfort, with admin verification, driver management, and passenger protection features.
- [Study Notes Viewer](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/study-notes-viewer): Building a modern web application for managing and organizing study notes with embedded content support, progress tracking, and rich markdown rendering capabilities.
- [Nexterm](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/projects/nexterm): Building an AI-powered terminal emulator that brings intelligent assistance to command-line workflows with natural language processing, error explanations, and context-aware suggestions.

## Articles

- [The Art of Minimalism in Design](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog/the-art-of-minimalism): Exploring how less truly becomes more in the world of visual design and user experience.

- [Finding Creativity in Constraints](https://www.abhirupkumar.in/blog/finding-creativity): Why limitations can be your greatest asset in the creative process.
